data.summary: Beispiel Energie AG informs Mara Beispiel that it is raising its electricity prices effective 1 January 2026: the monthly advance payment (Abschlag) rises from €72.00 to €81.00, with the energy rate (Arbeitspreis) going from 31.48 to 34.92 ct/kWh and the base fee (Grundpreis) from €12.90 to €13.90 per month. Because of this price change, the customer has a special right to terminate the contract without notice under §41(5) EnWG.
data.explanation: Your electricity supplier is increasing its prices from 1 January 2026, which will raise your monthly advance payment by €9.00. German law gives you a special right to cancel this contract without the usual notice period when a supplier raises prices like this — the app will show you until when you can use this right. The cancellation must be in text form (e.g. letter, e-mail, or fax). If you do nothing, the higher prices and advance payment simply take effect on 1 January 2026. If you're unsure whether to switch supplier, comparing offers before deciding can be worthwhile.
